My test itself has a bug: I can't encode a lone surrogate into the raw text. I need to use the JSON escape `\ud800` in the raw JSON text (which is valid JSON and decodes to a lone surrogate in Python). Let me fix that test to use the literal escape sequence in the JSON source.

Let me rewrite the surrogate tests properly.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp/tests && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='t_validation.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("""raw('{"jobs":[{"services":[{"name":"\\ud800","label":1}],"limits":%s,"events":[]}]}'%LIM, INVALID, 'lone surrogate in name is job-invalid... but json cannot encode')""",
'''raw('{"jobs":[{"services":[{"name":"A","label":1}],"limits":%s,"events":[{"op":"stage","epoch":1,"policy":"\\\\ud800"}]}]}'%LIM, JOBINV, 'lone surrogate policy -> job invalid')
raw('{"jobs":[{"services":[{"name":"\\\\ud800","label":1}],"limits":%s,"events":[]}]}'%LIM, JOBINV, 'lone surrogate name -> job invalid')
raw('{"jobs":[{"services":[{"name":"A","label":1}],"limits":%s,"events":[{"op":"stage","epoch":1,"policy":"\\\\ud800"},{"op":"inspect"}]}]}'.replace('{"op":"stage","epoch":1,"policy":"\\\\ud800"},','')%LIM, {'results':[{'events':[{'ok':True,'active':None,'images':[],'units':0,'contexts':0,'connections':0,'packets':0,'files':0}]}]}, 'inspect on fresh job')''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
cd /workspace/tmp/tests && python3 t_validation.py 2>&1 | grep -v '^ok'
